gloss: one way or another; all in all; when all is said and done

definitions.gloss: one way or another; for various reasons; despite everything
definitions.explanation: Indicates that despite various circumstances, complications, or concerns, something ultimately happens or is true. Often implies acceptance of a result after considering multiple factors.

definitions.gloss: all in all; when all is said and done; in the end
definitions.explanation: Used to summarize or conclude after considering various aspects, often revealing a positive underlying truth despite surface-level complaints or issues.

notes:
PATTERNS:
・なんだかんだ⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧(⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧) - When all is said and done; despite what one says
・なんだかんだ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ - One way or another; for various reasons
・なんだかんだ + positive statement (often reveals underlying truth)

NUANCE:
Often used to express that despite surface-level negativity (complaints, problems, complications), the underlying reality is positive or acceptable. Common in conversational Japanese; it is too casual for formal writing or business correspondence.

VARIANT:
・なんのかんの(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧ - Same meaning (slightly more formal variant)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧ - In the end, after all
・⟦いろいろ→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧ - After various things (happened)
・⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧ - As expected, after all
